desc: Derive and confirm the equivalence: two active values a,b connect iff there exists some L <= threshold with a|L and b|L, i.e. lcm(a,b) <= threshold.
Implement DSU over only distinct active values (nums[i] <= threshold) with value->index mapping and find/union helpers.
Implement multiple enumeration with `first_divisor[L]` compression: for each active a, iterate L=a,2a,...<=threshold, set first if unset else union(a, first_divisor[L]).
Count components as distinct DSU roots among active values plus the count of input values strictly greater than threshold.
Validate both provided examples and edge cases (threshold=1, all nums>threshold, duplicated multiples, O(threshold log threshold) max-size performance).
Produce final `Solution.countComponents` with correct `List` import and clean DSU structure.
